description: XML External Entity (XXE) injection exploits XML parsers that process DTD external entity declarations, enabling local file disclosure (`file:///etc/passwd`), SSRF via `http://` entities, and DoS via Billion Laughs. Vulnerable Java APIs include `DocumentBuilder`, `SAXParser`, `dom4j`, `TransformerFactory`, `SAXReader`, `XMLInputFactory`, Xerces. Detect by injecting `<!DOCTYPE>` DTD with `SYSTEM` entity references. Tools: Burp Suite, wfuzz XML fuzz strings.
